CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (red at p0/current/n3), its presentation (coordinate listing), and a separate origin/status entry are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement tied to a specific content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify colored items (red/blue) with coordinates at current timepoints.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields explicitly distinguish identification of content from its provenance/status for current referents.

O.rationale: The report states how coordinates map to layout and provides explicit coordinate listings showing presentation/organization at current referents.
